name: growth-chart
title: Growth charts
description: Charts of operation counts or running time against input size: standard growth curves and measured points on linear or log axes, with a legend that toggles series, a readout at any n, a control for the largest n and a best-matching-curve hint.

height.description: Chart height in CSS pixels (a spec's "height" overrides it). The width follows the page column.

logBase.description: Base of the logarithm in "log n" and "n log n" (it only changes the constant factor).

integerN.description: Snap the readout and the largest-n control to whole numbers (a spec's "integer" overrides it).

slider.description: Show a control for the largest n when the spec has no "maxN" (then it ranges from a little above the smallest n to four times the spec's largest n). A spec's "maxN": false hides it.

logToggle.description: Show a button that switches the y axis between linear and log scale (a spec's "logToggle" overrides it).

fitCandidates.description: Curves compared with a series when its spec asks for a fit and names none.

fitCurve.description: Draw the best-matching curve, scaled to the series, as a dashed line.

names.description: Display names for curves by their canonical name, e.g. {"log n": "lg n"}; others are written in maths notation (n², n log n, 2ⁿ, n!). A curve's own "label" wins.

locale.description: Locale for number formatting (e.g. "en"); empty = the reader's browser locale.

xLabel.description: Name of the x axis (input size) and of the variable in the readout; a spec's "xLabel" overrides it.

yLabel.description: Title of the y axis, drawn above it; empty = none. A spec's "yLabel" overrides it.

maxLabel.description: Label of the largest-n control; {x} is the x-axis name.

logLabel.description: Button that switches the y axis to a log scale (pressed = log).

legendLabel.default: Curves shown (press to hide or show)
legendLabel.description: Accessible name of the legend, whose entries are toggle buttons.

atLabel.description: Heading of the readout above the legend values; {x}, {n}.

seriesAt.description: Readout of a data series whose nearest point is at another n; {v}, {x}, {n}.

hiddenValue.description: Readout value of a hidden curve.

noValue.description: Readout value where a curve is undefined (e.g. log n at 0).

chartLabel.default: Growth chart for {x} from {min} to {max}. Use the arrow keys to move the readout.

cursorText.description: Spoken value of the chart's readout position; {x}, {n}, {values} ("label value" pairs).

fitLabel.description: Accessible title of the dashed best-fit line; {factor}, {curve}.

fitTooFew.default: {series}: too few points to compare with a curve.
fitTooFew.description: Shown for a series that asks for a fit but has fewer than three usable points; empty = nothing.
